name: session-read-by-a-foreign-session-is-invalidated-without-an-epoch
description: Session A opens a snapshot session; session B presents A's LIVE token. The owner is derived from the request's `session_id`, never from the token, so B is refused `session_invalidated` -- and this refusal carries NO `coordinator_epoch` (the raised-exception arm), unlike fixture 03's. A client that keys epoch-change detection off every session response must not assume the field.
